title: From the Diary of Anne Frank

topics.title: Before You Read: Anne Frank and kinds of personal records

concepts.learning_objective: Recall who Anne Frank was, when and why she kept her diary, and why it became famous.
Distinguish a diary, a journal, a log and a memoir by their features.

topics.title: Why Anne keeps a diary and calls it Kitty

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why Anne feels she has no true friend and turns to a diary.
Interpret Anne's decision to treat her diary as a friend named Kitty.

topics.title: A brief sketch of Anne's life

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the main facts of Anne's family and their move from Germany to Holland.
Infer Anne's feelings for her grandmother and her teacher Mrs Kuperus.

topics.title: The class meeting and Mr Keesing's essays

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the class's anxiety about the meeting that decides promotion.
Recall the three essays Mr Keesing set and how Anne answered each.
Evaluate what the chatterbox episode reveals about Anne and Mr Keesing.

topics.title: Language study: compound words, phrasal verbs, idioms and contracted forms

concepts.learning_objective: Identify compound words from the lesson and the part of speech they form.
Work out the meanings of phrasal verbs and idioms used in the lesson.
Expand contracted forms correctly and explain their use in diary language.
